limitations: Dated maintainer observations, not continuous monitoring or third-party certification. Implemented capability states describe source, not hosted availability.

The historical Tessera storage-quota incident is preserved. A concurrent maintainer release passed a narrow 8/8 hosted smoke; independent public health/instructions probes later passed. Fresh native artifact/report readback and sustained operation remain unverified. Account billing state and any new spending authority were not independently inferred from this recovery.

Latest recorded Tessera PR13 and home releases come from inspected concurrent receipts/logs; their executable hashes were not independently rebuilt/downloaded. Five other versions remain historical. Fresh public Tessera reads do not identify its executable version or qualify new learning paths; Herma remains undeployed.

Seven distinct native harnesses have completed a narrow lifecycle across historical hosted and fresh local fixtures. OpenMuse TypeScript has no verified connector; no universal feature/version/provider qualification is claimed.

Ten native Pi processes and 100 logical HTTP clients are historical different tests, with shared scoped cohort principals. Sustained separate-account scale and live adaptive-window pressure remain unverified.

Earlier 7/10 and 3/3 native waves, a corrected submission and a provider disconnect with unknown usage remain preserved. Native OS clipboard behavior was not tested; the 16 rendered Firefox cases used clipboard API stubs.
Tiny CPU/GPU LoRA training used random-initialized weights and synthetic data. Pretrained Meta training, useful-task improvement, Kaggle jobs and Glimmer training remain unrun.

Local seed-pack tests use the actual service and deterministic worker code through FastAPI TestClient; they are not separate-process native harness, hosted import or public admission proof. Kinema example media digests are synthetic.

Provider authentication, successful inference, native execution and deployment are distinct. Anthropic and OpenRouter calls were rejected; provider-reported diagnosis is not a measured account balance or invoice. Unknown usage remains reserved.

Community sources were reviewed at different static depths, without installing or executing them or reproducing benchmarks. Fourteen noun and twelve verb candidate shapes across six bundles are not imported, enqueued, executed or admitted packs.

General category/profile resolution, general shim admission/activation/rollback and independent Frontier candidate admission remain incomplete. Legacy inference-path attribution is not universally migrated.
No newsletter mailbox, active feed/inbox collector or general recurring research scheduler is enabled. Creative outputs and community mappings remain proposals.
No complete reconstruction of inaccessible session histories is claimed. Raw conversations, credentials, private identities and account details are excluded.

Anthropic and OpenRouter remain paused by owner direction. Explicit disable and managed-conversation shared recovery are merged and locally tested, including recognized-origin operator-key proxy pause with explicit caller credentials preserved. Hosted deployment is held; automatic health does not extend to the ordinary proxy or all legacy inference paths.

Herma shared-health PR10 and accounting PR11 are merged with matching-head/main CI and offline source checks. Deployment remains held; changed standard-tier request fields have no new live qualification.

Additional concurrent Tessera 12/13, Eranos5 and hackathon-context4 merges have read-only metadata/CI evidence in this snapshot; they do not inherit earlier local execution or deployment observations.
PR13 Worker observation read is not HTTP-routed; current learner use is Python-side, fuzzy matching is word overlap and weights are advisory. No demonstrated real-work improvement.
The home daily schedule is recorded configuration with no completed hosted daily/manual-cycle evidence. Prior rendered banner checks do not qualify its new UI.

Concurrent PR12 reports first-uploader visibility for identical-byte blobs within one namespace; per-uploader governance migration remains open. This reconciliation did not independently review that implementation.
